body:
The held `Canonicalizer` already spans both HIR and plan roots of one exact comparison. Its closure lookup still authenticates and allocates a one-frame Vec before checking the memo, and canonical-state traversal constructs fresh frame/open storage. Memo authentication still creates a large Diagnostic-bearing Result carrier on every call. This is distinct from #833 identifier-census backing reuse.

Give this exact comparison a retained authenticated scratch/receiving owner bound to immutable automaton, function, current ReplayBudget and active ledger. Reuse funded closure cursor/canonical frame backing across calls and both roots; prepay actual growth and overlap, clear retained references on every path, and retain the original cache-hit work debit and sticky exact-owner authentication. Redesign internal receiving so repeated success does not construct a fresh large error carrier. Every new lease/local/Result/Option must be accounted at its real construction; deleting a fee for a constructor that still exists is forbidden. Keep ordinary/no-owner routes and complete old receivers.

Measured source d6bf still fails actual production #808 codec compilation under the 67,108,864-byte live builder budget; production inner operation is unknown. The library witness first refuses a 136-byte factored memo authorization carrier. Its 48,840,045-byte debit is aggregate final-HIR validation including a cfg(test) oracle, **not** production document_end or cleanup-only spend. Discovery at b3e4e2b71 establishes repeated source constructions, not their frequency, app contribution or gains. No cap-fit/token claim.

Acceptance: exact full old/current canonical outputs/IDs/signatures/weights/work/arithmetic/refusal order; separately measured full construction, reservation, actual allocation/peak and Drop; zero/exact/one-short growth, nested scopes, foreign/stale/restored payer and sticky zero-byte reuse. Reject stale/foreign views without touching foreign authority and never allocate after exhausted payment. Preserve all original source/graph audit joins, complete immutable originals and full inverse chains. At the batch boundary run only exact new/affected owners, unchanged #808 production native/project and builder recovery selectors, and scoped Clippy. No full suites/gates. App compilation completion and matched live agent efficiency remain separate evidence. No cap increase, refunds, authority donation, baseline padding, oracle weakening, or deletion of still-existing constructor charges.
title: (OPT) Retain authenticated canonicalizer scratch and receiving across comparison roots
